title: The High Wreck
author: Dominic Montrose
blurb: Ansel Okafor, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
